news.title: I trust Troy Jackson to fight for working-class Mainers | Letter
news.description: Recently I attended a political event for Troy Jackson in Portland. There were about 65 people there and Jackson was relaxed, approachable and friendly. He gave a reasonable speech, putting forth middle-of-the-road Democratic positions that the audience approved. Although he did not have the rousing delivery of Graham Platner, there was a hopeful, enthusiastic feeling [...]
